title: Rusty Dime's band, first band; manager Blunt and who read music
summary: Vincent's first band was led by cornetist Wesley Dimes; he managed it then handed it to violinist Jasper Blunt. Most of the band read music except the drummer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
